title: Kotak Mahindra Bank among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 15% in a month - Fresh Highs | The Economic Times
text:
On Friday, the benchmark Sensex gained 413 points to close at 74,729. Amid the market rally, five stocks from the BSE 500 index touched fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and may indicate increased investor interest and trading activity.

New 52-week high: Rs 1223.5| CMP: Rs 1199.15. In the last month, the stock gained about 15%.

New 52-week high: Rs 1426| CMP: Rs 1400.1. In the last month, the stock gained about 12%.

New 52-week high: Rs 453| CMP: Rs 446. In the last month, the stock gained about 8%.

New 52-week high: Rs 776.25| CMP: Rs 772. In the last month, the stock gained about 8%.

New 52-week high: Rs 2086| CMP: Rs 2059. In the last one month stock has gained about 8%.
